mappings.note: Links a large infrastructure project, the skilled operation of a bulldozer and the salary it earns: several scales of economic activity (CG-SST4) around one named occupation (LO-297).
The same act of teaching classed differently by whether it is paid: the economic/non-economic line (CG-SST4) drawn against teaching as a profession (LO-297).
Asks whether the economic/non-economic split is really clean, with the artist and the home food business as mixed cases; a reflection on the classification, so CG-SST4.
Explains value addition for a profession the pupil chooses: the market concept (CG-SST4) applied to an occupation (LO-297).
Farmers building a check-dam unpaid for shared benefit, and the later earnings it may bring: collective non-economic work with economic consequences, so CG-SST4.
Recalls the uniform and garment shop Anu's parents run - a named occupation, hence LO-297.
The knitting skill Anu's mother teaches in a voluntary group; unpaid contribution, so CG-SST4.
Rohan's profession as a software engineer - a named urban occupation, so LO-297.
The computer skills Rohan volunteers to teach; unpaid work contrasted with his paid job, hence CG-SST4.
Defines the market as the place of exchange - CG-SST4 names the market among the institutions to be understood.
Defines a fee as payment for professional advice or service; a form of compensation, so CG-SST4.
'Money's worth' as the value a person places on a thing for the benefit it gives - market vocabulary, hence CG-SST4.
Names activities done from love, care and respect as non-economic; the classification, so CG-SST4.
Defines salary as a fixed regular monthly payment - a form of compensation, under CG-SST4.
The highway being built near Kamlapur: public infrastructure (LO-294) generating work and economic benefit (CG-SST4).
Payment in kind as non-cash compensation; a form of payment, so CG-SST4.
Vivekananda's counsel to treat work as the highest worship: a value from an Indian system of thought (LO-300) about the worth of work (CG-SST4).
Two post-retirement activities of Kabir's grandfather, both unpaid - the value of work beyond pay, so CG-SST4.
How Anu's parents divide the running of their shop between them: the occupation (LO-297) and the household economy around it (CG-SST4).
Asks for an economic activity from the story and gets Geeta Aunty's salaried flying: the classification (CG-SST4) applied to a named occupation (LO-297).
Asks for a non-economic activity from the story and gets Rohan's volunteering - the classification, so CG-SST4.
A damaged duplicate whose supplied answer works through Rohan's paid software work and the social value of his volunteering: the two kinds of contribution (CG-SST4) from one profession (LO-297).
A riverfront clean-up by volunteers supported by municipal equipment and disposal: unpaid civic work (CG-SST4) meeting the local government's provision (LO-294).

Geeta Aunty's salaried service, the grandfather's garden for the family, and how selling the surplus would change its character: the classification (CG-SST4) across named occupations and self-provisioning (LO-297).
